actions.description: Launch the authored fixed-army dwarf puzzle through the practice picker.
Select the supplied army through Mission controls.
Resume the shared simulation and activate emplacement through the ordinary HUD button.
Assign and recall a real control group with keyboard input.
Select the cannon through its HUD roster button, then right-click the firing shelf on the native canvas.
Emplace the cannon at the firing shelf and wait for damage from its real weapon.
Pause with the HUD, open Mission controls, and download a mission checkpoint.
Reset the puzzle and compare the complete new checkpoint with the original launch.
Load the downloaded checkpoint through the normal file input.
Resume the restored cannon order until the authored objective completes.
Choose the authored dwarf finale and move the supplied army into the boss sight.
Center the army using its visible selection control so the active warning can be inspected.
Start the dwarf campaign through its campaign card.
Solve the campaign first chapter with the same visible army, roster, ability and pointer controls.
Export the verified campaign profile, reload the page, and resume its stored completed chapter.
Continue to the second chapter and prepare the inherited detachment with the normal ability button.

definition.title: The Long Shot
definition.briefing: Bryn has one cannon and a small escort. The quarry tower outranges the unprepared gun. Emplace the cannon on the western firing shelf, protect it from the Ironjaws, and destroy the marked tower.
definition.successText: The tower falls from the prepared shelf. Bryn brings the quarry workers inside the Mountain Keep before the warband returns.
definition.failureText: Bryn or the cannon is lost. Reset and prepare the firing position before engaging the tower.

objectives.text: Emplace at least one unit and destroy the quarry tower. Keep the cannon alive.
Keep Bryn Deepforge alive. The army and zero-resource budget are fixed; reset restores this starting position.
